We are submitting the first milestone for the Midnight-enabled Medical Records Data Platform. This includes all outputs we outlined for this stage, including initial app design, UX/UI flows and the fesibility research. Our goal with this platform is to provide a secure and privacy-focused environment for managing sensitive baby care data.
This milestone reflects our progress toward building a functional proof of concept that can evolve in parallel with Midnight’s mainnet development. By preparing both the application infrastructure and privacy mechanisms early, we aim to be among the first teams to demonstrate real-world utility for Midnight. All supporting materials and deliverables can be found in the links below.
Milestone outputs:
・Link to public drive with a pdf document outlining the Midnight research report outputs

ms.report:
・The video below demonstrates the implementation of the end-to-end flow to store and retrieve sensitive personal/medical records using Midnight (testnet) instead of a centralized database, ensuring confidentiality and provenance. The demo shows a complete, running pipeline: after sign-in and a quick check of existing records, the app presents the Midnight wallet and testnet contract context, then executes the full write path—generate a per-record AES key, encrypt the case data, upload the ciphertext to Pinata (IPFS hash), and commit (childId, AES key, IPFS hash) on Midnight. It then proves the read path by resolving on-chain pointers, fetching from IPFS, and decrypting back to plaintext in-app, while confirming the centralized DB holds only minimal metadata. Video link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1zvdumkakTiZwiFY1gdtIELhflwkEAeRb/view

ms.report:
Project Close-Out Report 
Project Title: Midnight-enabled Medical Records Data Platform / App 
Project ID: 1200149 
Technology Partner: Blazar Labs 
Status: Completed 
Delivery Month: October 2025 
Repository: https://github.com/blazarlabs-io/Midnight_Medical_Records/tree/develop

1. Summary of What Was Done 
We entered this project with the ambition to support XOBaby, a startup focused on improving newborn care through IoT-enabled baby carriers, while exploring the capabilities of Midnight and it’s selective disclosure feature, for managing medical data privacy. 
The project’s objective was twofold: 
・To deliver a mobile application for XOBaby’s IoT baby carrier products, enabling secure collection, storage, and visualisation of newborn health data. 
・To explore Midnight’s potential as a privacy-preserving data management layer for sensitive health information. 

Key milestones included defining the application design and Midnight integration architecture, developing the mobile app interconnected with IoT data feeds, and implementing smart-contract functionality to manage access rights on the Midnight testnet. 
We successfully delivered all outputs originally committed to under this proposal. The resulting solution securely interconnects parents, clinicians, and researchers through encrypted, role-based access control. All source code, documentation, and integration designs have been open-sourced. 
The project timeline extended beyond initial estimates due to two main factors: 
・A six-month search for a reliable Midnight developer, given the scarcity of available expertise during the chain’s early evolution. 
・Evolving system requirements following updates to Midnight’s SDK and API, which required adjustments to our architecture and integration logic.

Despite these challenges, the Proof-of-Concept was completed successfully and demonstrates a functional privacy-focused healthcare data system leveraging Cardano technology.
